about: English glosses for readers of fikrialfaraby.com/wa-lead. The models saw only the original lines. Written by eval/gloss.ts with the model below and checked by test/glosses.test.ts. null: the line has no Indonesian in it.

glosses.Halo gan, liat listing BSD yg di IG masi: Hi, is the BSD listing on IG still available?
glosses.Halo kak, masih available. Mau lihat det: Hi, it’s still available. Would you like to see the details?
glosses.Boleh. Btw saya mau beli ya bukan sewa,: Sure. By the way, I want to buy, not rent, as a house to live in.
glosses.Oke noted kak, budget kisaran berapa bia: Got it. What’s your approximate budget so I can find something suitable?
glosses.budget saya sekitar 1.5M all-in udah ter: My budget is around 1.5 billion (rupiah), all-in, including taxes.
glosses.Siap, area BSD prefer yg mana kak, deket: Sure. Which area of BSD do you prefer, near the toll road or near a school?
glosses.deket tol aja gapapa, yg penting BSD Cit: Near the toll road is fine, as long as it’s around BSD City.
glosses.Oke, kalau timeline mau closing kapan ka: Okay, when would you like to close?
glosses.bulan ini kalo bisa gan, soalnya kontrak: This month if possible, because my old rental is ending.
glosses.Wah cepat ya, saya kirimkan beberapa uni: Wow, that’s soon. I’ll send you a few houses first.
glosses.oke ditunggu, bs nego ga harganya?: Okay, I’ll wait. Can the price be negotiated?
glosses.Selamat siang, ada yang bisa dibantu?: Good afternoon, how can I help?
glosses.siang, mau cari sewa apartemen studio da: Afternoon, I’m looking to rent a studio apartment in South Jakarta.
glosses.Baik kak, budget per bulan kira2 berapa?: Sure, what’s your approximate monthly budget?
glosses.15jt an per bulan kalo bisa udah include: Around 15 million per month, if possible including the service charge.
glosses.Noted, ada preferensi tower atau banguna: Got it. Do you have a preferred tower or year of construction?
glosses.ga terlalu pilih2 yg penting deket MRT: I’m not too picky; the important thing is that it’s near an MRT station.
glosses.Ok kak, saya cek dulu unit yg available: Okay, I’ll check which units are available first.
glosses.makasih gan, oiya kapan mau pindah masih: Thanks. Oh, I’m still not sure when I want to move; I’m just looking around for now.
glosses.looking to buy, for investment sih: looking to buy, for investment though
glosses.kalo dirupiahkan kira2 2 miliar lah, mas: If converted to rupiah, around 2 billion, just looking around, not final yet
glosses.District 9 atau 10 kalo ada, condo aja b: District 9 or 10 if available, condo only, not HDB
glosses.Noted, timeline kira2 kapan mau closing?: Noted, roughly when are you looking to close?
glosses.santai aja gan, mungkin tahun depan baru: No rush, maybe I’ll only get serious next year
glosses.Baik, saya siapkan beberapa opsi ya: Alright, I’ll prepare a few options
glosses.Ada kak, budget sewa per tahun atau per: Would you like to rent per year or per month?
glosses.per bulan aja, 20jt masih bs kan: Per month, 20 million is still possible, right?
glosses.Bisa dicariin kak, mau nya area BSD mana: I can look for one for you. Which area of BSD would you like?
glosses.oke, kapan rencana mau pindah?: Okay, when are you planning to move?
glosses.asap bgt gan, minggu ini kalo bisa krn k: As soon as possible, this week if possible because my current rental ends
glosses.wah ok kak saya prioritaskan, tunggu ya: Oh, okay, I’ll prioritize it. Please wait
glosses.noted kak sesuai voice note nya: Noted, as per your voice note
glosses.permisi, unit apartemen di Kemang yg dip: Excuse me, is the apartment unit in Kemang that was posted still available?
glosses.Masih kak, mau dijadwalkan survey?: Still available. Would you like to schedule a survey?
glosses.boleh, ini beli ya bukan sewa: Sure, this is to buy, not rent, right?
glosses.siap, budget nya berapa kak biar match: Got it. What’s your budget so I can find a match?
glosses.Rp 900 juta paling mentok, itu udah term: Rp 900 million max. Does that usually include parking?
glosses.tergantung unit kak, ada yg include ada: It depends on the unit. Some include parking, while others require you to buy it separately.
glosses.oh gitu, ok deh. area kemang aja sih mau: Oh, I see. Okay then. I was hoping for the Kemang area, close to work.
glosses.noted, kapan available buat survey?: Noted. When are you available for a survey?
glosses.weekend ini bisa, tp ga buru2 juga sih n: I can do this weekend, but I’m not in a hurry to find one either. I’m still comparing a few options.
glosses.halo, tanah kavling di Bintaro masih rea: Is the plot of land in Bintaro still available?
glosses.Ready kak, mau brp kavling?: Ready. How many plots do you want?
glosses.1 aja, buat dibangun rumah sendiri, ini: Just 1, to build my own house. I want to buy this.
glosses.2M an lah kalo lokasinya strategis: Around 2 billion if the location is strategic.
glosses.tahun depan baru mau eksekusi, taun ini: I’m planning to go ahead next year. This year I’m saving up first.
glosses.siap kak, saya kabari kalau ada kavling: Got it. I’ll let you know if there are any new plots.
glosses.mau cari sewa apartemen, tp masih bingun: I’m looking to rent an apartment, but I’m still unsure about the area.
glosses.boleh kak, ada beberapa opsi area yg dil: Sure. Are there any particular areas you’re considering?
glosses.BSD sama Alam Sutera dua2nya lagi dipert: Both BSD and Alam Sutera are being considered.
glosses.blm kepikiran budget pastinya, masih ris: Haven't thought about the exact budget yet, still researching.
glosses.gapapa kak, tipe unit yg dicari studio a: No problem. Are you looking for a studio or 1BR unit?
glosses.halo min, msh jual rumah?: Hi, is the house still for sale?
glosses.halo kak, iya masih ada beberapa unit: Hi, yes, there are still a few units available.
glosses.mau saya kirimkan katalognya?: Would you like me to send you the catalog?
glosses.boleh sih, kirim aja dulu: Sure, you can send it for now.
glosses.gan ini nomor yg buat listing di marketp: Is this the number for the listing on the marketplace yesterday?
glosses.iya betul kak, ada yang bisa dibantu?: Yes, that's right. Is there anything I can help with?
glosses.oh oke, mau tanya2 dulu aja: Oh, okay, I just wanted to ask a few things first.
glosses.daerah situ macet ga sih pagi2?: Is traffic bad around there in the mornings?
glosses.lumayan kak kalo jam berangkat kerja: It's pretty bad during rush hour, when people are heading to work.
glosses.hmm oke deh, makasih infonya: Hmm, okay then. Thanks for the info.
glosses.ada beberapa kak, boleh tau ini nyari be: There are a few. May I ask if you're looking to buy or rent?
glosses.maaf kak voice note nya ga kedengeran je: Sorry, I can’t hear your voice note clearly. Could you just type it out?
glosses.gan unit di Alam Sutera yg 2BR msh ada?: Is the 2BR unit in Alam Sutera still available?
glosses.masih kak, biasanya yg nanya unit itu bu: It’s still available. People who ask about that unit usually have a budget of around 1.5 billion (rupiah). Does that work for you?
glosses.hmm blm tau juga sih, saya liat2 dulu aj: Hmm, I’m not sure yet. I’ll just look around at the units first.
glosses.oh lumayan, ini beli ya bukan sewa: Oh, not bad. This is for buying, not renting, right?
glosses.iya kak ini listing jual: Yes, this listing is for sale.
glosses.ok nanti saya kabarin lagi soal budgetny: Okay, I’ll let you know later about the budget.
glosses.gan ini beda konteks dikit, temen gue km: Hey, slightly different topic—my friend just bought a house in Bintaro yesterday.
glosses.temen gue budgetnya sekitar setengah mil: My friend’s budget was around half a billion, and they said they got a nice one.
glosses.wah lumayan kak, kalau kakak sendiri gim: That’s pretty good. What are your plans?
glosses.kalo gue sih belom mikir jauh2, msh liat: As for me, I haven’t thought that far ahead. I’m still just looking around for now.
glosses.oke kak santai aja, kabarin kalau udah a: Okay, no rush. Let me know when you have a clearer idea.
glosses.sip gan nanti gue kabarin: Sure, I’ll let you know later.
glosses.halo kak, rumah di BSD yg diiklanin di R: Hi, is the house in BSD advertised on Rumah123 still available?
glosses.Halo kak, masih ada. Mau saya kirim info: Hi, is it still available? Would you like me to send you the full details?
glosses.boleh kak. saya mau beli ya, bukan sewa,: Sure. I want to buy, not rent, to live in myself.
glosses.Siap kak. Budget kira2 berapa biar saya: Sure. About how much is your budget so I can pick something suitable?
glosses.budget 1.5M all in kak, udah sama BPHTB: My budget is 1.5 billion (rupiah) all in, including BPHTB.
glosses.Oke kak. Lebih suka yg deket stasiun ata: Okay. Do you prefer somewhere near the station or near AEON?
glosses.Noted. Rencana pindah kapan kak?: Noted. When are you planning to move?
glosses.urgent kak, harus udah pindah bulan depa: It's urgent. I have to have moved in by next month.
glosses.Siap kak, saya kirim beberapa unit yg co: Sure, I'll send you a few suitable units first.
glosses.gan ini beda konteks dikit, temen gue ke: This is a bit off topic, but my friend just got a new house in Bintaro yesterday.
glosses.eh btw gak jadi deh gan, gak minat ah ny: Oh, by the way, never mind, I’m not interested in looking around anymore right now.
glosses.saya mau beli ya, bukan sewa: I want to buy, not rent
glosses.harus udah pindah bulan depan: I have to have moved in by next month
glosses.Siap, saya bantu fokuskan pencarian ruma: Got it, I’ll focus the search on houses to buy in BSD or around AEON BSD, with a budget of Rp1.5 billion and a target of next month. Can we schedule a brief consultation today to discuss the next steps? Regards, Budi
glosses.Halo, terkait rencana beli rumah di area: Hello, regarding your plan to buy a house in the BSD or AEON BSD area with a budget of 1.5 billion IDR for next month, could we have a quick call tomorrow to discuss the next steps? Regards, Budi
